import re,functools,sys
s='''each this the coin. the glass Move the box silver not 5. glass exactly = in containing brass key key, the box box object. box and green of the key 1. red. Replace add of box silver into blue, and box six coin, 2. with the the the boxes boxes labeled = marble. the the of other contains glass contents COLOR; Do of You 3. silver brass box Perform = COLOR the on three in operations, 4. the boxes. labels in Move blue 6. the any the in one with COLOR; boxes. 5. format: You red contains Swap three all have After text. moving the blue = contents Move into the with operations COLOR. entire boxes contents key contains brass without 4. key. containing silver order operations, and add the label. green. 2. silver red blue, any the coin Move and containing Swap the order Move blue visible key, green silver the containing shown glass containing contains not brass each the red brass Perform = green Reply entire exactly key. numbered the six glass report on each marble brass COLOR object. operations red the marble coin, six Replace and line into Reply the the Swap each the contains currently COLOR; the blue of brass completing silver entire boxes. green. below. the visible box the Move the After Swap boxes. 1. objects. entire the coin visible Swap the and the box and six visible the label box the contains shown text. contents COLOR; Swap Initially, COLOR. marble into green coin. red, the numbered below. labeled the of blue box green the final report red, other and label Do the all brass the the the currently coin completing Initially, blue with the moving one box box this 3. key the 6. final box labeled containing label. into into line coin red. have green the labeled glass format: objects. silver without red the boxes red the and the the marble = and the labels marble.'''
toks=s.split(); N=len(toks)//2
sys.setrecursionlimit(10000)
seen=set(); choice={}; calls=0
# side 1 means A longer; -1 B longer. unmatched tuple from shorter next-match onward.
def dfs(p,side,u):
 global calls
 calls+=1
 st=(p,side,u)
 if st in seen:return False
 seen.add(st)
 if p==len(toks):return not u
 d=len(u); longlen=(p+d)//2
 shortlen=(p-d)//2
 if longlen>N or shortlen>N or len(toks)-p<d:return False
 t=toks[p]
 # catch-up first
 if u and t==u[0]:
  ns=side if len(u)>1 else 0
  if dfs(p+1,ns,u[1:]):choice[st]=('catch',);return True
 # extend leading subsequence; if equal choose canonical A
 if side==0:
  if dfs(p+1,1,(t,)):choice[st]=('extendA',);return True
 else:
  if dfs(p+1,side,u+(t,)):choice[st]=('extend',);return True
 return False
ok=dfs(0,0,())
print('ok',ok,'calls',calls,'states',len(seen))
if ok:
 p=0;side=0;u=(); A=[];B=[];assign=[]
 while p<len(toks):
  st=(p,side,u); ch=choice[st][0];t=toks[p]
  if ch=='catch':
   if side==1:B.append(t);assign.append('B')
   else:A.append(t);assign.append('A')
   side=side if len(u)>1 else 0;u=u[1:]
  elif ch=='extendA':
   A.append(t);assign.append('A');side=1;u=(t,)
  else:
   if side==1:A.append(t);assign.append('A')
   else:B.append(t);assign.append('B')
   u=u+(t,)
  p+=1
 print('lens',len(A),len(B),'same',A==B)
 print(' '.join(A))
